title: Wind-turbine wake fields
review_mode: read-only review of retained scientific/equation/evidence records; no fitting, acquisition or new literature search
review_scope: Original findings, first continuation when present, latest continuation and supplemental material-response tasks when present. Independent computational review is a separate artifact.
grouping_and_information_scope: Whole actuation controls in one wind tunnel; correlated interpolated lidar cells; new task additionally permits no-turbine background calibration.
portfolio_disposition: Scoped numerical references, tested hypotheses and preserved falsifications; no independently established new fundamental law or demonstrated deployment impact is admitted.
aggregate_score_reason: Scientific dimensions are distinct; task difficulty and validation scope are disclosed without converting them into invented precision or a composite discovery score.

finding_reviews.statement: The original Gaussian/shear field reconstructs one reserved control, with insufficient evidence for an actuation law.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.
finding_reviews.strongest_adverse_evidence: One reserved control and source-interpolated cells do not establish wind-farm or energy transfer; the later coordinate/background repair changes information access.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Whole actuation controls in one wind tunnel; correlated interpolated lidar cells; new task additionally permits no-turbine background calibration. Strong adverse evidence: One reserved control and source-interpolated cells do not establish wind-farm or energy transfer; the later coordinate/background repair changes information access.

mechanism.rationale: Flat-core wake shape and background calibration are established descriptions. Source contrasts support rotor-aperture redistribution, not a newly identified momentum/turbulence or frequency law.

novelty.rationale: Source publication already analyzes induction and wake recovery; claimed contribution is matched calibration and bounded shape comparison. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Whole actuation controls in one wind tunnel; correlated interpolated lidar cells; new task additionally permits no-turbine background calibration.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.

scientific_validators: Keep WT 2 local 2 D/4 D distinct from global 7 D/9 D in empty-field mapping.
Declare empty-flow calibration identically for every competitor and do not compare gains to lower-information original task as algorithm-only effects.
Aggregate by complete actuation control; retain rotor-disk versus whole-plane contrast distinction.
finding_reviews.next_evidence: Fresh inflow/turbulence/actuation repeats with independent rotor power and uncertainty estimates.
